Patients with GBM must meet the RANO criteria of measurable disease (10 mm × 10 mm)

candidate_evidence.quote: A monoclonal antibody that binds to CD93, DCBY02 will be administered as a single intravenous (IV) infusion on Day 1 in each 21-day cycle.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The malignancy must have progressed after at least 1 available standard therapy for incurable disease

must have a lesion that can be biopsied with acceptable clinical risk and agree to have a fresh biopsy at Screening and an on-treatment biopsy.

role_evidence.quote: to assess the effects of anti-CD93 mAb (DCBY02) as a monotherapy in patients with advanced or metastatic solid tumors

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: monoclonal antibody that binds to CD93

coder_notes: Basket phase 1; GBM named in inclusion criteria with its own RANO measurability rule and exempt from the biopsy requirement. Paired biopsies apply to non-GBM patients; the pharmacodynamic objective is stated for Part 2, so target engagement coded yes. PK is plasma only (no tissue PK planned). Hypoxia/PD-1 resistance is mentioned as rationale, not as a biomarker requirement.
